reflection_theorem.statement: for even k and odd v, f_{k,k-v}(x)=-x^k f_{k,v}(-1/x), so C(k,k-v) is similar to -C(k,v)^(-1); if N=ord(C), reflected order is lcm(2,N) when -I is absent and N/gcd(N,N/2-1) when C^(N/2)=-I
